metadata.description: Collection de plugins Claude Code du groupe Guyeux (FEMTO-ST, Université Marie et Louis Pasteur) : phylogénomique évolutive bactérienne, génétique des populations humaines, rédaction scientifique et outillage transverse.

plugins.name: mtbc
plugins.description: Academic research toolkit for computational genomic studies of the Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex (MTBC): phylogenomics, comparative genomics, lineage assignment, antimicrobial-resistance allele frequencies from published research isolates, and TB surveillance literature. Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST, Universite Marie et Louis Pasteur), peer-reviewed research only.

plugins.name: bacteria
plugins.description: Academic research toolkit for comparative genomics of bacterial pathogens across genera: Yersinia, Leptospira, Helicobacter, Salmonella, non-tuberculous mycobacteria, and the Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex for everything that is method rather than TB-specific data. Genome assembly and characterisation, species and clade identification, core-genome MLST clonality, ab initio mobile-element detection, CRISPR content, strain and isolation metadata, from published research isolates. Genus-specific resources live here alongside the genus-agnostic methods; the pipeline soldered to the group's TB data stack (TBannotator, bdd/actuelle, WHO catalogue, SITVIT) lives in the mtbc plugin instead. Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST).

plugins.name: popgen
plugins.description: Academic research toolkit for ancient and modern human population genetics, archaeology, paleoclimate, linguistics and historical migration corpora, plus host-pathogen co-evolution. Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST), peer-reviewed research.

plugins.name: ia
plugins.description: Machine learning, statistics and data science toolkit: classification, dimensionality reduction, causal inference, model explainability, applied to genomic and other research data. Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST).

plugins.name: maboss
plugins.description: MaBoSS / CoLoMoTo toolkit: .bnd/.cfg Boolean-model authoring (official refcard grammar), the pyMaBoSS API and Oscar Dufossez's CCT temporal-logic evaluator, and the ecosystem map (WebMaBoSS by Vincent Noel, model repositories, positioning vs INDRA). For cancer signalling modelling and the mabossDemo literature-coherency project.

plugins.name: ops
plugins.description: Outils pour les projets PrédictOps, OptimOps, DoctrinOps.

plugins.name: droit
plugins.description: Academic research toolkit for French legal scholarship (droit public, constitutionnel, penal, droit de la nationalite et de la citoyennete): detailed references in footnotes following the conventions of Camille Aynes' doctoral thesis, and verification of case-law and statutory citations against official sources before publication.

plugins.name: multimedia
plugins.description: Outils multimédia : sous-titrage de films muets, audio/vidéo, synthèse vocale, métadonnées de films.

plugins.name: phylo
plugins.description: Academic research toolkit for phylogenetic and phylodynamic inference: tree building (RAxML-NG, IQ-TREE), molecular dating (BEAST2, LSD2), ancestral reconstruction, and iTOL annotation. Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST), peer-reviewed research, transverse to all taxa.

plugins.name: bioinfo
plugins.description: Generic bioinformatics libraries and registries: Biopython, pysam, sequence retrieval, ontologies, the STRING network, Nextflow pipelines. Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST), peer-reviewed research, transverse to all taxa.

plugins.name: structure
plugins.description: Academic research toolkit for structural bioinformatics: protein structure prediction and complex modelling (Boltz, ESM Atlas), pocket detection, active-site validation, small-molecule handling. Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST), peer-reviewed research.

plugins.name: litterature
plugins.description: Academic literature-mining toolkit: full-text and supplementary-table recall, open-access resolution, systematic review synthesis, biomedical entity annotation. Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST), peer-reviewed research, transverse to all domains.

plugins.name: science-commun
plugins.description: Transverse scientific toolkit used across every research domain of the Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST): figures and maps for publication, PDF extraction, remote compute, problem selection, statistical analysis.

plugins.name: redaction
plugins.description: Manuscript writing and quality control: LaTeX typesetting, reference and figure verification, stylistic cleanup, table design, Overleaf synchronisation. Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST), phases 2-3 of the research cycle.

plugins.name: diffusion
plugins.description: Submission and dissemination of a finished manuscript: journal targeting, reviewer response, conference posters and talks, Zenodo deposit. Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST), phase 4 of the research cycle.

plugins.name: carriere
plugins.description: Funding applications, CV maintenance and grant proposals for the Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST). Activated manually, outside the research-project cycle.

plugins.name: cycle
plugins.description: Research-project lifecycle toolkit: five-phase cycle with closure gates, decision gates on whether findings are worth writing up and disseminating, research-leads registry, lab notebook, consolidated state of knowledge, pre-flight and post-result adversarial checks, reframing and scope triage, model/effort routing under usage quotas, dataset versioning and drift detection, project scaffolding. Domain-agnostic: usable for phylogenomics, other sciences, or any long-running research project. Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST), academic research workflow.
